$comment: Cases every implementation of policy/risk.yml and policy/autonomy.json must pass: bin/check-policy's reference matcher here, and hq#210's gate in sk-ctl, which reads this file from the same agent-plugins commit. Each case runs once per repo in repos ("*" means every repo in risk.yml's repos) with author (matched by id) and files (path, status, additions, deletions; optional old_path for a rename's old path, base_mode and head_mode as git modes, and binary for a diff with no patch). want gives the class and flags it must get, and optionally the author's level and the route ("gate" when the level lets the gate merge the class, else "owner"). The first cases are hq#205's (tools/merge_gate/test_merge_gate.py at hq de93ba3).
